title: Verify lease queue fairness
progress_summary: FIFO handoff for the host verification lease shipped. QueueRecord ranks claimants by (priority, arrival, target) as a strict total order, a freed lease goes to the lowest-ranked claimant, and a claimant that leaves an in-process wait keeps its turn as a TTL-bounded reservation. verify.lease.status now lists the queue in service order. Integration test freed_heavy_lease_travels_the_queue_in_arrival_order proves arrival-order handoff and that a non-waiting acquire cannot overtake. PR #4185 is MERGED into develop with all 19 CI checks green; Issue #4169 AC-1..AC-5 are checked and the closure comment is posted.
